manifest.summary: Rolls up every ad-hoc media script (subtitle hardbaking, video enhancement, library sorting, dedupe, manga scraping, image work, a Japanese tutor) into one local app with a shared console, progress bar and Kill button. Nothing phones home except metadata / translation lookups you switch on yourself.

features.name: Subtitle Studio
features.description: Batch video to MP4 with a burned-in sub track: embedded track, external .srt/.ass, translate-then-burn (Jan / Google / DeepL), or Whisper transcribe-then-burn for raws. Track Inspector via ffprobe. CPU or Intel-GPU (VAAPI/QSV) encoder, CPU by default.

features.name: Video Enhancer
features.description: Upscale resolution, motion-interpolate to 60/120 fps to de-stutter, tune I-frame / scene-change compression.

features.name: Library Organiser
features.description: Point at a messy folder: anitopy parses names, AniList/Jikan/TMDB give canonical title + year, preview a shallow one-folder-per-series tree, Apply (move/copy/hardlink). Every run writes a manifest for later Revert. Hash-check skips already-sorted files and exact dupes. Name clash can route the source into <library>/_DUPLICATES/. Never deletes.

features.name: Anime Library
features.description: Read-only health view of the centralised library: every series with year, season/episode counts and size; missing-episode gaps; episodes still holding both an .mkv and an .mp4; a name check.

features.name: Duplicate Slayer
features.description: PDF or image folder: perceptual-hash pages, auto-keep-first or manual thumbnail review, rebuild an optimised PDF/CBZ. For scraped manga.

features.name: Storage Tools
features.description: SQLite file index that survives restarts; instant name/size/ext search, largest-first, duplicate-file finder with one-click extra-copy delete, dead-entry cleanup.

features.name: Manga Downloader
features.description: Selenium scrape (comix.to / manhuaus / generic), pattern-mode pagination, parallel chapters, PDF/CBZ. Incremental-scroll fetch with height-growth checks and retries to avoid the missing-pages bug.

features.name: AI Image Studio
features.description: fal.ai text-to-image / img2img with your key, plus a fully-local Lanczos/bicubic upscaler + unsharp needing only Pillow.

features.name: Japanese Tutor
features.description: Chat backed by your running Jan model, click-to-type kana keyboard, formal/casual register and persona.

features.name: Settings
features.description: Encoder choice, API keys, paths, optional-dependency status.

manifest.data_dir: ~/MediaForgeData/ (settings.json, file_index.db, anime_title_cache.json, manifests/ - organise/sort manifests are never auto-deleted, they back Revert)
services: AniList / Jikan / TMDB (Library Organiser canonical titles)
fal.ai (AI Image Studio, user API key)
Google / DeepL via deep-translator (optional translate backends)

required: ffmpeg + ffprobe (system; ffmpeg 9 with h264_qsv/h264_vaapi here so the Intel-GPU toggle works)
optional: selenium + a Chromium browser - Manga Downloader

manifest.standalone_launch: .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn web_app:app --port 8422   (run.py launches the legacy customtkinter desktop app)
manifest.api_base: /api/  (38 routes in web_app.py: jobs+SSE, thumbnail, settings, encoders, storage, anime-library, subtitles, enhance, dedupe, organizer, jptutor, imagestudio, manga)
cli_tools: tools/anime_sorter.py - consolidate a scattered collection into one shallow canonical library, manifest-backed revert, duplicates parked in _DUPLICATES/
known_gaps: Duplicate Slayer review thumbnails aren't retained, so they can be GC'd blank; _compile can IndexError if every image in a group fails to load. Manga-only path.
Anime Library docstring mentions a 'Fix names' button that isn't wired (only 'Name check' exists).
Library Organiser _edit_row maps a text click to a row via (line-1)//2, correct only while every row is exactly 2 lines.
The user's external-drive anime sort is paused: the NTFS drive 14DE4324DE42FD8C could not be mounted unattended. A prior run already sorted 2211 files; finish via finish_anime_sort.sh once mounted.
